column1: # tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv — is a component READ FROM THE SOURCE, or did the
# 229,449 of 665,582 component records (34.47%) were never stated by the source the record
# cites. They are pipeline output: injected mineral bases, an injected oxygen exchange, a
# canonical base medium expanded from its name, and blanket "hydrolysate approximations"
# that turn one undefined ingredient into 35 metabolites. Nothing in index.json, the browser
# table, media.parquet or the coverage number distinguishes them, so a medium built entirely
# from guesses can and does display "Coverage 100%" in the green high-confidence band
# The operator's decision is SEGREGATE AND LABEL: none of these records are deleted. They
# stay, flagged as derived-not-sourced, excluded from the honest coverage denominator, and
# This table is the SINGLE definition of that split. tools/stages/stamp_provenance.py reads
# it and HARD-FAILS on any mapping_method not listed here, so a newly added source can never
# be silently classified by a default. That hard failure is the test: the corpus currently
# uses 55 distinct mapping_method values and every one of them must have a row.
#   sourced   the component corresponds to something the cited source states
#   derived   the pipeline supplied it; the source does not state it
# derived_class (empty for sourced rows) — three classes, because they carry different
# warrant and collapsing them into one bucket would be a false equivalence:
#   inferred_from_listed_ingredient  the ingredient IS in the recipe; its breakdown into
#   injected_convention              nothing in the recipe corresponds to it at all
#   canonical_base_expansion         a named, published base medium (M9, MOPS, LB) expanded
#                                    from its name; the base's own reference is recorded

A fixed 35-metabolite block (20 amino acids + 6 nucleosides + 9 vitamins) injected whenever ANY ingredient was flagged undefined, each at lower_bound -1.0. It is a constant, not an estimate of the ingredient. 100,619 components; none carry derived_from, so they cannot be traced back to what triggered them.
